content: Cefotetan disodium for injection is provided as a dry powder that ranges in color from white to pale yellow. It is available in vials containing cefotetan disodium equivalent to 1 gram or 2 grams of cefotetan activity, intended for intravenous (IV) or intramuscular (IM) administration. These vials must be stored at temperatures not exceeding 22°C (72°F) and should be protected from light. The following vial presentations are available: 1 g ADD-Vantage Vial (NDC 0310-0376-31) 2 g ADD-Vantage Vial (NDC 0310-0377-32) 1 g Vial (NDC 0310-0376-10) 2 g Vial (NDC 0310-0377-20) 1 g Piggyback Vial (NDC 0310-0376-11) 2 g Piggyback Vial (NDC 0310-0377-21) Cefotetan is also supplied in a 10 g pharmacy bulk package: 10 g in a 100 mL Vial (NDC 0310-0375-10) Additionally, cefotetan injection is available as a frozen, iso-osmotic, premixed solution in single-dose Galaxy® plastic containers (PL 2040) in the following configurations: 1 g in a 50 mL plastic container (NDC 0310-0378-51) 2 g in a 50 mL plastic container (NDC 0310-0379-51) The frozen containers should be stored at or below -20°C (-4°F).
